mapper.sql: id, process_id, tenant_id, provider, enabled, site_url, login_username, login_password_enc, login_pin_enc, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO process_auto_fetch (process_id, tenant_id, provider, enabled, site_url, login_username, login_password_enc, login_pin_enc, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{processId}, #{tenantId}, #{provider}, #{enabled}, #{siteUrl}, #{loginUsername}, #{loginPasswordEnc}, #{loginPinEnc}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE provider = VALUES(provider), enabled = VALUES(enabled), site_url = VALUES(site_url), login_username = VALUES(login_username), login_password_enc = VALUES(login_password_enc), login_pin_enc = VALUES(login_pin_enc), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by), updated_at = NOW()
